newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW gets new Lower Saxony rep on supervisory board.
newsitem.headline: VW gets new Lower Saxony rep on supervisory board.

text.p: Gerhard Glogowski, interior minister for the state of Lower Saxony, is to join the supervisory board of German car maker Volkswagen AG, the region's state government said on Tuesday.
Lower Saxony owns 20 percent of Volkswagen's stock and has the right to appoint two representatives to the board.
Glogowski, who was appointed to the board by the Lower Saxony state government, will succeed the state's former social minister Walter Hiller, who has retired.
The second Lower Saxony seat on the VW board is held by state premier Gerhard Schroeder.
